scenicChapters.title: Quebrada de las Conchas
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 68 km this is Quebrada de las Conchas, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

quebrada-de-las-conchas.story: Out of Salta, one way: 401 km, roughly 6 h 44 in the saddle. It goes by way of Alemania, Amphitheatre and Devils Throat. The highest point is about 3,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
